levels.1: Protect long-term rank, upgrade, challenge, and collectible progress before large cleanup sessions.

areas.name: Difficulty and Nightmare
areas.location_cue: The campaign lobby fields for Difficulty, Enemy Setup, and player capacity.
areas.note: Brutal is a difficulty preset; Nightmare is a separate redesigned enemy configuration.

levels.1: Finish upgrades and learn each route before removing interface support.
levels.2: Obtain a recorded Brutal clear on every installed campaign mission.
levels.3: Select Brutal in the difficulty field, use the normal enemy setup first, and complete each mission from its opening chapter through results. Brutal removes the HUD and discards ammunition left in a magazine when reloading, so verify every mission tile records the setting afterward.

levels.1: Treat this as a redesigned encounter pass rather than a larger ordinary enemy count.
levels.2: Clear every supported campaign mission with Nightmare selected as the enemy setup.
levels.3: Nightmare is separate from difficulty and supports one or two players. Select it in Enemy Setup, use a survivable difficulty for the first pass, and clear every mission from its opening chapter; confirm the Nightmare record on each tile rather than relying on a final-chapter shortcut.

levels.1: Save the combined preset until the arsenal and five-perk loadout are fully developed.
levels.2: Complete a full mission with Brutal difficulty and Nightmare enemy setup active together.
levels.3: Host a one- or two-player lobby, select Brutal and Nightmare simultaneously, begin at the mission's opening chapter, and stay on those settings through the final results screen. Use completed weapon masteries and five Gold perks; changing either field invalidates this maximum-variant run.

levels.1: Let campaign, challenge, Horde, and mastery cleanup supply most experience before farming.
levels.2: Raise the persistent career rank to 100.
